name: Paid Ads Daily Performance - Press Burger Portal

parameters.jsonBody:
={{
{
  query: "SELECT
    segments.date,
    campaign.id,
    campaign.name,
    campaign.status,
    campaign.advertising_channel_type,
    metrics.cost_micros,
    metrics.conversions,
    metrics.conversions_value,
    metrics.clicks,
    metrics.impressions,
    metrics.ctr,
    metrics.average_cpc
  FROM campaign
  WHERE segments.date DURING YESTERDAY
    AND campaign.status != 'REMOVED'
    AND campaign.advertising_channel_type IN ('SEARCH', 'DISPLAY', 'PERFORMANCE_MAX')"
}
}}

={{
{
  query: "SELECT
    customer.id,
    campaign.id,
    campaign.name,
    campaign.status,
    campaign.advertising_channel_type,
    ad_group.id,
    ad_group.name,
    ad_group_ad.ad.id,
    ad_group_ad.ad.name,
    ad_group_ad.status,
    ad_group_ad.ad.type,
    ad_group_ad.ad.final_urls,
    ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_search_ad.headlines,
    ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_search_ad.descriptions,
    ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_search_ad.path1,
    ad_group_ad.ad.responsive_search_ad.path2,
    ad_group_ad.ad.expanded_text_ad.headline_part1,
    ad_group_ad.ad.expanded_text_ad.headline_part2,
    ad_group_ad.ad.expanded_text_ad.description,
    metrics.cost_micros,
    metrics.conversions,
    metrics.conversions_value,
    metrics.clicks,
    metrics.impressions,
    metrics.ctr,
    metrics.average_cpc
  FROM ad_group_ad
  WHERE campaign.status != 'REMOVED'
    AND ad_group_ad.status != 'REMOVED'
    AND campaign.advertising_channel_type IN ('SEARCH', 'DISPLAY')"
}
}}

={{
{
  query: "SELECT
    customer.id,
    campaign.id,
    campaign.name,
    campaign.status,
    campaign.advertising_channel_type,
    asset_group.id,
    asset_group.name,
    asset_group.final_urls,
    asset_group.status,
    metrics.cost_micros,
    metrics.conversions,
    metrics.conversions_value,
    metrics.clicks,
    metrics.impressions,
    metrics.ctr,
    metrics.average_cpc
  FROM asset_group
  WHERE campaign.status != 'REMOVED'
    AND asset_group.status != 'REMOVED'
    AND campaign.advertising_channel_type = 'PERFORMANCE_MAX'"
}
}}

nodes.name: Google Ads searchStream - PMax Asset Groups

parameters.content:
Workflow: Paid Ads Daily Performance - Press Burger Portal

Runs daily at 6:00 AM Pacific and syncs YESTERDAY. Configure workflow timezone to America/Los_Angeles in n8n.

This replaces the older partial Google Ads workflows operationally.

Campaign Daily query includes SEARCH, DISPLAY, and PERFORMANCE_MAX.

Search/Display ad-level rows now store responsive search/expanded text creative fields for text preview cards.

Performance Max is included in daily_performance and campaign_daily_performance; lifetime PMax asset groups are stored as ASSET_GROUP rows when available. Image asset URLs are only populated when Google Ads exposes a usable URL.

Store visits are pulled from Google Ads dedicated metrics: metrics.all_conversions_from_store_visit, with metrics.all_conversions_from_location_asset_store_visits as a fallback. This keeps primary metrics.conversions unchanged while capturing ad-attributed store visit goals.

Writes to three portal tables:
1. public.daily_performance
2. public.campaign_daily_performance
3. public.ad_lifetime_performance

Secrets are read from environment variables; do not hardcode exported keys.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{
{
  query: "SELECT
    customer.id,
    campaign.id,
    campaign.name,
    campaign.advertising_channel_type,
    asset_group.id,
    asset_group.name,
    asset_group_asset.field_type,
    asset_group_asset.status,
    asset.id,
    asset.name,
    asset.text_asset.text,
    asset.image_asset.full_size.url,
    asset.image_asset.full_size.width_pixels,
    asset.image_asset.full_size.height_pixels
  FROM asset_group_asset
  WHERE campaign.status != 'REMOVED'
    AND asset_group.status != 'REMOVED'
    AND asset_group_asset.status != 'REMOVED'
    AND campaign.advertising_channel_type = 'PERFORMANCE_MAX'"
}
}}
